Thanks Anjali — great to meet Michael on the call. Quick introductions and the escalation/role matrix so everyone's clear before Tue's handshake:

Internal (Redwood):
- Rishi Malhotra (rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com) — Exec sponsor (VP, Strategic Accounts). Primary escalation owner for commercial/SLA exceptions.
- Stephanie Nguyen (stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com) — Solutions lead; will own technical onboarding, trial runbook, and weekly status.

- Michael Chen (michael.chen@solsticehealth.com) — Exec sponsor (CTO).
- Anjali Rao (anjali@solsticehealth.com) — Project lead (technical).
- procurement@solsticehealth.com — Procurement lead for contracting.

Escalation path (short):
1) Technical blocker -> Steph (solutions) in first 24 hours.
2) If unresolved >48 hours with impact to trial milestones -> Grace (CS) + Rishi for prioritization.
3) Exec-level risks (security/regulatory or SLA miss) -> Michael + Rishi for immediate alignment.

Quarterly outcomes (success criteria we will hold to the MAP):
- Performance: p99 inference latency <= 150 ms for targeted workloads (2k token baseline).
- Reliability: Trial demonstrates >= 99.9% request success over a two-week steady-state window.
- Security: Successful private VPC deployment with KMS integration and audit log exports validated by Solstice security.
- Economics: Demonstrated unit costs within agreed cost window; Redwood to provide batching/quantization suggestions to meet targets.

I've uploaded an updated worksheet with assigned owners and a week-by-week checklist: MAP_Solstice_v2.xlsx (attachment). Also linking our HubSpot deal and the SOW DocuSign we can pre-fill once procurement signs off.

- HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/12345/892
